inputs.disk: one saved preboot 64MiB ext4 template copied separately for each variant; initial SHA256 equality required

acceptance: Original must pass before candidate is attempted
Each variant reports exactly the expected 94 distinct test names once, all ok, with success exit and unique success marker
Original tracked regular files equal fixed archive before and after; candidate differs only by exact archived four-file proposal
Resolved config and lockfiles remain fixed; generated Cargo configs require path-aware comparison
Preboot template is unchanged; both runs begin with its exact bytes
budget: 600 seconds per make invocation, kill after 10 additional seconds
cache_policy: Original may reuse verified original outputs; candidate builds in fresh isolated outputs. No timing or performance comparison.
limits: Not a normal non-unittest production build check
Not all-config equivalence or performance validation
Passing tests does not establish net maintainability benefit or justify merging
